document: Ballot Backlash: BC Conservatives open 8-point lead after snap election call, but electorate far from locked in (Angus Reid Institute, 2026-09-24)
note: Online, Angus Reid Forum, n=801. Shares among decided and leaning voters from the release PDF chart 'B.C. provincial vote intent (Decided and leaning voters)' (2026.09.23_BC_Elxn_1.pdf, p. 6); n = bases printed on the chart (Fraser Valley flagged as small sample). The release does not split 'Other party' into OneBC/CentreBC (Wikipedia's 4/3/3 split is not in the ARI release); AUTRES = 'Other party'. The PR tables (QBC4a+QBC4b) give shares including undecided only. Region labels verbatim; 'Island/ North' coded VANCOUVER-ISLAND-NORTH-COAST (same ARI region as 'Island/ North Coast').
